$comment: Shared policy for every flow. Shapes and semantics: flows/schemas/shared.schema.json (read its descriptions before changing run_allowlist). Validated by scripts/sdlc_runner/manifest.validate_shared and pinned by tests/test_sdlc_manifest.py.

run_allowlist.$comment: Any other arguments: pytest runs the project's own tests. --basetemp is removed recursively before use, so it is refused; an ini or root outside the project is refused; @file argument files (pytest 8.2+) could carry either.
Only as `python -m unittest`; there is no unittest program on PATH.
Any environment; `tox exec` (alias e) runs an arbitrary command and -x/--override can rewrite the commands, so they are refused; a config, root or work folder outside the project is refused.
Sessions come from the project's noxfile; a noxfile outside the project is refused.
Any arguments; a config, root, setup, runner, environment or reporter (code) outside the project is refused.
Any arguments (prefer `vitest run`); a config, root or setup file (code) outside the project is refused.
Any arguments; options that load code (require, import, loader, ui, reporter, file, config, package) must name a path inside the project.
Only `playwright test`; the other subcommands install browsers or open tools.
Any arguments; --require/-r load code and -I adds a load path, so a path outside the project is refused.
Any arguments; -d sets php.ini values (auto_prepend_file loads code), so it is refused; a bootstrap, configuration or include path outside the project is refused.
Only `go test` and `go vet`; -exec, -toolexec, -vettool and -ldflags (-extld) run another program and are refused; an overlay or module file outside the project is refused.
Only `cargo test`; --config can set a target runner program, so it is refused.
Only `dotnet test`; adapters and run settings outside the project are refused, and so are @file response files that could carry them.
Only the test and verify phases (put flags after the phase); a POM or settings file outside the project is refused.
The project's Maven wrapper, resolved in the run's directory inside the project; same restriction as mvn.
Only the test and check tasks (put flags after the task); build, settings and init scripts, a Gradle user home (its init.d scripts run) and included builds outside the project are refused.
The project's Gradle wrapper, resolved in the run's directory inside the project; same restriction as gradle.

Only the test and check targets; --eval runs inline make code, and command-line variables that swap the shell, make's own flags or the compilers (the --env refusals) are refused; a makefile outside the project is refused.

`npm test`, or `npm run <script>` with a script named in run_scripts; options that swap the script shell, inject Node options or read another config are refused, and --prefix (another package's scripts) must stay inside the project.
`pnpm test`, or `pnpm run <script>` with a script named in run_scripts; same refusals as npm, and --dir/-C must stay inside the project.
`pnpm exec <program>` with a JavaScript test or check tool from this list (shell mode is never an allowlisted program).
`yarn test`, or `yarn run <script>` with a script named in run_scripts; same refusals as npm, and --cwd or a yarnrc must stay inside the project.
`yarn <program>` (a package binary) with a JavaScript test or check tool from this list; a bare script name needs `yarn run`.

`npx <program>` with a JavaScript test or check tool from this list, so -c/--call (a shell string) never runs. The runner adds --no: without a TTY npx would install a missing package from the registry and run it.
`uv run <program>` with a Python test or check tool from this list (uv options before it are refused).
`poetry run <program>` with a Python test or check tool from this list.
`bundle exec rspec`.
Only `python -m <module>` with a listed Python module; -c and script paths are refused.
Only `python3 -m <module>` with a listed Python module; -c and script paths are refused.
The Windows launcher: only `py [-3] -m <module>` with a listed Python module.
Only `ruff check` and `ruff format` (`ruff server` never exits).
Any arguments; a config, rules folder, formatter, parser or plugin (code) outside the project is refused.
Type check with any arguments (use --noEmit to leave output files alone).
Any arguments; a config file (it can name plugins) or an interpreter outside the project is refused, and so are @file argument files that could carry either.

pytest.$comment: 1 tests failed; 2 interrupted or collection error, 3 internal error, 4 usage error, 5 no tests collected.

unittest.$comment: 1 failures or errors; 2 usage error; 5 no tests ran (Python 3.12+).

go.$comment: 1 a test or build failed; 2 usage error.

mypy.$comment: 1 type errors found; 2 crash or usage error.

ruff.$comment: 1 violations found; 2 configuration, option or internal error.

eslint.$comment: 1 lint errors; 2 configuration or internal error.

tsc.$comment: 1 and 2 type errors (output skipped or written); 3 invalid project, 4 project reference cycle.

escalation.$comment: A spec grows into its implementation; the package runs as feature work.
A spec is drafted and the plan's spec: rewritten (design §5.11).
Test work that needs production changes becomes feature work.
Triaged feedback that is a defect becomes bugfix work.
